fusions.name: Doubling Back
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 25% health: you loop back on it and deal 22 damage, up to 1.5 times that from 6 tiles away.

fusions.name: Scattered Musk
fusions.desc: Kicks up a ring of musk that deals 10 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocks them 2.5 tiles back. Each has a 30% chance to turn on its allies for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Briar Hideaway
fusions.desc: Veils you and your allies for 6 seconds, and you move 15% faster while it lasts. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Wrong Scent
fusions.desc: Each debuff laid on you has a 20% chance to be sent back to its source instead.
